171592.overview: A 3d Pac-Man homebrew game by Matthias Domin with a surprising leap forward in Pac-Man technology.  You can jump!

177987.overview: The first homebrew title programmed for the Jaguar dates back to 1995, which was a Jaguar version of Tetris called JSTetris (often referred as Jaguar Tetris or JagTris) developed using a hacked Jaguar (BJL, ROM replaced by custom software).
